1. CI provenance - failure, intentional protected-path policy rejection

2026-11-05T01:26:15.0897819Z Error: CI provenance: changes to protected CI authority require a separately reviewed trusted-base policy update: tools/windows_desktop_facts/EVIDENCE.md, tools/windows_desktop_facts/README.md, tools/windows_desktop_facts/evidence/20261104-2359/CAPTURE_SHA256.json, tools/windows_desktop_facts/evidence/20261104-2359/SHA256.json, tools/windows_desktop_facts/evidence/20261104-2359/electron.json, tools/windows_desktop_facts/evidence/20261104-2359/electron.process.json, tools/windows_desktop_facts/evidence/20261104-2359/failed-dpi.json, tools/windows_desktop_facts/evidence/20261104-2359/failed-dpi.process.json, tools/windows_desktop_facts/evidence/20261104-2359/generation-boundary-review.json, tools/windows_desktop_facts/evidence/20261104-2359/high-contrast-size.json, tools/windows_desktop_facts/evidence/20261104-2359/high-contrast-size.process.json, tools/windows_desktop_facts/evidence/20261104-2359/inputs.json

Cause: The base-owned pull_request_target verifier's protectedPath predicate unconditionally includes p.startsWith("tools/"). It rejects any protectedChanges; its error displays only the first 12 paths. PR1401 changes tools/windows_desktop_facts paths, including the listed evidence and documentation. No evidence-content validation failed in this step.
Disposition: This PR triggers the existing trusted-base admission policy. It is not an infrastructure failure and the workflow policy itself was not introduced by this PR. No claim is made about unrelated main-run health.
Owner/action: CI authority/provenance policy maintainer must handle a separately reviewed trusted-base policy change, or the PR author must legitimately rescope the protected-path changes. Do not self-authorize a guard exception in this PR. Same-head rerun or ordinary PR/CodeRabbit approval cannot change the current predicate. EVIDENCE.md and further receipts under this tools directory remain protected by the same rule.

The publisher awaits checks.create with conclusion=failure, then intentionally throws when verified is false. The synthetic KELD VeriSentry check is attached to the current PR test-merge SHA.
Disposition: Expected propagation of the provenance failure; no independent publisher credential, API, or runner error is shown.
Owner/action: Same provenance policy owner and disposition as item 1. No separate publisher source fix is supported by the evidence.
